_note: 3_01 'Jealous Johnny' — Johnny Vincent hires Jimmy to tail Gord and Lola's date and photograph three poses: hand-holding, the flower gift, the kiss (recon: docs/re-notes/ch3/3_01-jealous-johnny.md). PHOTO PRIMITIVES — the pragmatic v1 call: 'taking the photo' is our timed hold-interact (minigame_launch with camera framing text at the alley edge), NOT a real photo mode — photo_mode (aim mode + reticle + shutter) and photo_capture_condition (target-in-frame AND pose-predicate latch) are recorded as pending (they want the camera HUD work; the camera itself is 1_S01's grant). The couple's date loop (npc_pair_date_loop — five random non-repeating alley spots, 7 kiss cycles) compresses to three FIXED spots in sequence (every run offers all three shots, so the finite-opportunity soft-lock fail 3_01_ONOPIC can't happen — documented); the spook distance band meter and the spotted break-and-jeer loop are skipped (the meter's consumer is engine-side INFERRED; the break is non-hostile — spotted_pause_resume pending; note the walkthrough's 'spotted fails' claim is WRONG per the script, VERIFIED there); the containment watchdog (leave the area -> fail) is skipped (its triggers are area-0 volumes; the mission plays in one neighborhood); the hand-off's approach-to-0.8m + GivePhotos anim + gift callback 32 is our social + pair_anim. Item 526 photos are granted per shot and taken back at the hand-off. Pass pays $20 via the campaign on_pass (M_PASS 2000); greasers +5 is relative (omitted). Wording is original; ped_model_id records the original model ids next to the stand-in meshes.
title: Jealous Johnny

stages.objective: Johnny Vincent has a job for you.

on_start.sub: New Coventry. Johnny looks like hell.

lines.speaker: JOHNNY
lines.text: Hopkins. My Lola's been seen with that Aquaberry rat Gord. Follow them. Get me PHOTOGRAPHS — holding hands, gifts, the works. Then we talk.

on_start.speaker: JIMMY
on_start.text: There they are. Johnny wasn't kidding.

on_complete.speaker: JIMMY
on_complete.text: And three. Johnny's not going to like this.

on_complete.speaker: JOHNNY
on_complete.text: ...She's kissing him. You did good, Hopkins. The greasers owe you.
campaign on_pass for 3_01 pays $20 (M_PASS 2000); greasers +5 relative omitted; bulletin-board wiring (BB_18) noted
